original.statement: Istio adds the env var SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER (default 0.01), which randomizes certificate renewal timing by about +/- 15 minutes around the 12-hour renewal.

decision.reason: [ev-d0223398edc4] says SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER is a new setting with a default of 0.01. That default adds a random offset of about +/- 15 minutes to certificate renewal timing. Environments that leave the variable unset get this new behaviour. Environments that set it explicitly choose their own value. So the exposure condition env-var{SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER, unset} matches the environments where the behaviour change happens: it is neither broader nor narrower.
